blocks.comment: The face of a cliff of soft rock or of earth cut steep, seen from its side (uv.y up): beds laid one over another, the harder ones standing out with a shadow under them, gullies the rain cut down it, cracks, and pebbles in it. Its colors are neutral: a ground tints each bed by its height in the world, so no bed comes back with the tile.
